seed_ledger.reason: Montour Steam Station (Montour CT Project, two 655 MW combined cycle units, 1310 MW, 2031): EXISTING_ROW, the June 2026 PA DEP air permit application says gas comes from the existing pipeline on the Montour property, which matches roster row P0317 Montour Lateral Pipeline; the application lists new data center construction among the reasons for the load growth, though it calls any separate data center project independent, so the tie is weak, and the DataCenter tag is a lead for review. Brunner Island (1616 MW coal to gas): NO_DC_TIE, Talen owns the existing lateral to Texas Eastern, no new pipe and no data center tie found. Searches run: 3. Sources checked: PA DEP Montour CT air permit application (existing pipeline, data center demand named among reasons); DCD story on Talen rezoning near Montour (data center campus, separate); Talen Brunner Island plant page (conversion, no data center); Talen 2016 Montour co-firing exhibit (earlier lateral plan).
